content.title: Chapter 91 - SPECIAL DISTRICTS — Sec. 91-6. - Growth limitations.
content.summary:
The city shall not be limited in implementing city council or voter approved growth
               limitations, even though such actions may reduce or delay development within a district
               or realization of district revenue.
(
Ord. No. 4815
, § 1, 10-3-2022)
